Full-stack product engineer building an AppSec/SCA platform spanning autonomous AI remediation, vulnerability analysis, workflow automation, and multi-tenant platform infrastructure.

Built the core multi-ecosystem SCA remediation calculation engine for npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, and Ruby, including version-constraint parsing, minimum-safe-upgrade calculation, transitive dependency solutions, and CycloneDX dependency-graph traversal.

Designed and shipped an end-to-end AI-agent-driven “Fix Now” feature, orchestrating autonomous vulnerability remediation with LangGraph and AWS Bedrock, audit persistence, concurrency controls, and live execution tracking.
Designed a transparent package-manager proxy and repository-scoped agent memory system, allowing sandboxed remediation agents to safely resolve dependencies and retain context between runs.

Designed and led the migration of workflow automation from synchronous request execution to asynchronous workers with rate limiting, automatic abuse shutdown/notification, and execution observability.

Improved production reliability and scale by fixing scheduler deadlocks and double-enqueue bugs, redesigning Redis-backed LangGraph checkpointing, and adding caching/query optimizations for large tenants.
Drove a multi-month initiative to bring the Python backend under mypy --strict and enforce strict type checking in CI across workers, database, API, workflow, and remediation code.
Technologies used: Python, Golang, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Redis, AWS Bedrock, LangGraph, React, TypeScript, Docker, AWS ECS Fargate, AWS RDS, Terraform

Founder and full-stack product engineer building a browser-based platform for remote tabletop gaming that combines real-time voice/video, synchronized gameplay state, and computer-vision card recognition.

Founded and independently built cardcast.gg end-to-end, evolving a computer-vision prototype into a production, no-signup browser platform and authoring nearly its entire 536-commit history across product, ML, backend, frontend, infrastructure, and launch.

Migrated real-time media from an N² WebRTC mesh to a LiveKit SFU with room-scoped JWTs, adaptive streaming, simulcast/dynacast, reconnect handling, recording, and preserved 1080p source frames for recognition.

Architected a reusable ONNX Runtime recognition platform spanning card detection, batched DINO embeddings, top-K retrieval, validated model bundles, incremental Scryfall synchronization, and atomic hot-reloaded catalogs.

Built a six-platform CPU/CUDA/WASM/WebGPU benchmark suite and a 178-frame/2,205-crop evaluation corpus; measured 27.0 ms median detector inference on iPhone WebGPU and identified a 10.4 ms GPU segmentation architecture.

Built the authoritative eight-player gameplay backend and React experience, synchronizing turns, timers, life totals, commander state, card detections, and interactive virtual cards through typed WebSocket contracts.

Protected production gameplay from compute-heavy inference with service isolation, priority-aware backpressure, timeouts, circuit breaking, and observability across Sentry, PostHog, structured latency, and per-stage timings.
Technologies used: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React, TypeScript, WebSockets, WebRTC, LiveKit, ONNX Runtime, Docker, Terraform, Oracle Cloud, AWS
Multi-disciplinary engineer proficient in problem-solving and adept at wearing multiple hats. Committed to resolving persistent challenges within the product.

Spearheaded the implementation of an auto-scaling control plane, deploying product instances, and reducing developers' and QA team's workload by 10+ hours per week. Significantly accelerated QA times, achieving a 10x reduction.
Led the development of Attack Path Analysis, enabling companies to visualize network compromise routes taken by attackers.
Led the development efforts of the IAM subproduct, processing 10M+ rows daily for multiple Fortune 500 customers' IAM footprints.
Pioneered the development of the IAM Least-Privileged Access product, empowering customers to eliminate unused permissions from high-risk IAM users/roles.
Facilitated the onboarding of an 8-engineer team and a manager in Belfast, ensuring a smooth transition and effective collaboration.
Developed a comprehensive developer onboarding checklist, including instructional videos, now the go-to resource for onboarding 30+ engineers.
Resolved many long-standing issues in the product by diving deep and applying comprehensive fixes, not band-aids. (database weak refs, multiprocessing)
Technologies used: Python, MySQL, Redis, Terraform, AWS, ECS Fargate, RDS, GCP, Azure

In charge of developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for products that receive 100,000+ calls per day.

Developed a Python-based CLI deployment platform allowing for fully automated blue-green deployments with automated rollbacks in case of failures. Integrated this platform into the CI/CD pipeline, reducing deployment times from 2 days to 45 seconds.
Technologies used: Python, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Amazon ECS, Docker
Worked on a system to offer Capital One customers the ability to bring in their third party bank's financial details into a unified mobile and web experience (Plaid/Finicity).
Participated in developing the backend code for storage and retrieval of transaction data. Implemented a reference web-application for demo purposes and as a model for the Mobile experience.
a fully functional and robust CI/CD pipeline to support the project, enabling the team to perform blue/green deployments into production with the click of a button.

Lead developer of TESSMobile, an Android and iOS application for time entry. It is the de-facto industry standard within the intelligence community, downloaded over 50,000 times, business licensed to 2,000+.

Developed an Android and Desktop software suite for the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA). The application allowed forces abroad to access and robustly search a specialized database for pertinent information regarding their current situation. Currently being used by at least 27 people.
